sentences.text: Pankaj Kumar Mandal vs Unknown on 1 October, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
01.10.2024 rc/ct.no.34 Item No.260 Crr No.3223 of 2024 In the matter of : Pankaj Kumar Mandal
.......Petitioner Mr. Sourav Chatterjee Mr. Radrajit Sarkar Mr. Tamoghna Saha Ms. Vanshika Newar
...for the Petitioner The petitioner seeks quashing of criminal proceedings being G.R.Case No. 4184
of 2021 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barasat, North 24-Parganas.

Learned counsel for the petitioner takes this Court to an order passed by a coordinate Bench of this Court in CRR No. 1813 of 2022 on November 10, 2022 whereby this Court quashed the proceedings in G.R.Case No. 4184 of 2021 qua the petitioner.
The private opposite party thereafter filed an application under Section 173(8) of the Code of Criminal Procedure before the learned Trial Court seeking further investigation of the case.

The learned Trial Court, vide an order passed on June 22,
2023

, directed Inspector- in-Charge Eco Park Police Station to investigate the case further in respect of accused Sandhya Rani Mondal keeping in mind the order passed by this Court in CRR No. 1813 of 2022.

The Investigating Officer has submitted charge sheet upon holding further investigation against 7 accused persons including the present petitioner under Sections 498A/506 of the Indian Penal Code despite the case being quashed qua the petitioner by this Court.
It appears from the material on record that the petitioner has been able to make out an arguable case.
The petitioner is directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of January,2025.

Further proceedings G.R.Case No. 4184 of 2021 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barasat, North 24- Parganas be stayed qua the petitioner till January 31, 2025 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
